established.statement: In terms of the Killing vector $K^A$ of the ambient space for a given generator, the static-gauge formula for $\delta\phi$ is $\delta\phi = K^5\big|_{X=(x,\phi)} - K^\mu\big|_{X=(x,\phi)}\,\partial_\mu\phi$, where $K^5=K^\phi$ is the shift of the transverse coordinate and $-K^\mu\partial_\mu\phi$ re-fixes static gauge.

The spatial DBI-boost generator $M^{i\phi}$'s Killing vector in $dS_5$ (flat FRW slicing) satisfies the Killing equations without $H$-modification, giving $\delta_{M^{i\phi}}\phi = -x^i - \phi\,\partial_i\phi$ — the flat-space result, exact, with no $H$-corrections.

Applying the static-gauge formula with the temporal generator's $dS_5$ Killing vector gives $\delta_{M^{0\phi}}\phi = \frac{e^{-Ht}\sinh(Ht)}{H} + \frac{H}{2}\left(\vec{x}^2-\phi^2\right) - \phi\,\partial_t\phi + H\phi\,x^i\partial_i\phi$ — the temporal boost receives genuine $H$-corrections relative to the flat-space form.

The flat-space $M^{\mu5}$ generator, derived via the ambient transformation \eq{eq:ambient-transform} plus static-gauge refixing of the worldvolume label, induces $\delta\phi = -b^\mu\phi\,\partial_\mu\phi - b_\mu x^\mu$ on the brane embedding scalar, matching \texttt{2404.01894v2} up to the sign convention $b\to-b$.
